'''Football Club de Martigues''', known as '''FC Martigues''' or just '''Martigues''', is a French professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Martigues]], [[Bouches-du-Rhône]]. As of the 2025–26 season, it competes in the Départemental 3, the eleventh tier of French football.

The club plays at the [[Stade Francis-Turcan]], which has a capacity of 11,500, in [[Martigues]]. Their principal rivals are [[FC Istres|Istres]]."}}
